children: Incyte (
) today announced that it will present new data from its oncology portfolio during the European Society of Medical Oncology (ESMO) Congress 2026, being held October 23 - 27, 2026, in Madrid.

“The data being presented at ESMO further reinforce our confidence in these novel investigational approaches and their potential to improve and prolong the lives of patients with difficult-to-treat gastrointestinal cancers,” said Pablo J. Cagnoni, M.D., President, Incyte and Global Head of Research and Development. “Importantly, these findings not only provide new clinical insights, but they also inform our registrational development programs, including the Phase 3 KRAS G12D and TGFβR2×PD-1 studies already underway.”
Details on rapid oral presentations at ESMO include:
INCB161734 (KRAS G12D)
Safety and Efficacy of Oral KRAS G12D Inhibitor INCB161734 as Monotherapy or in Combination with Cetuximab (Cetux) in Patients (pts) with Advanced/Metastatic Colorectal Cancer (CRC)
Session: Rapid Oral session. Sunday, October 25, 3:30-5:00 a.m. ET (8:30-10:00 a.m. CET). Abstract #1007RO.
Safety and Efficacy of INCB161734, a Novel Oral KRAS G12D Inhibitor, in Combination with Chemotherapy in Patients (pts) with Advanced/Metastatic Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma (PDAC)
Session: Rapid Oral session. Monday, October 26, 9:45-11:15 a.m. ET (2:45-4:15 p.m. CET). Abstract #3137RO.
INCA33890 (TGFβR2xPD-1)
INCA33890, a TGFβR2xPD-1 Bispecific Antibody, with Standard of Care (SoC) Anticancer Therapies for Microsatellite Stable Colorectal Cancer (MSS CRC)
Session: Rapid Oral session. Saturday, October 24, 2:30-4:00 a.m. ET (8:30-10:00 a.m. CET). Abstract #1954RO.
INCB123667 (CDK2)
Preliminary Efficacy of INCB123667 (CDK2 Inhibition) with Bevacizumab in Recurrent Epithelial Ovarian Cancer (rEOC)
Session: Rapid Oral session. Friday, October 23, 10:15-11:45 a.m. ET (4:15-5:45 p.m. CET). Abstract #1241RO.
All regular abstracts accepted for presentation at the ESMO Congress 2026 are published online via the ESMO website, here.
All accepted abstracts will also be published online three weeks after the Congress in the ESMO Congress 2026 Abstract Book, a supplement to ESMO's official journal,
Annals of Oncology
. More information regarding this year’s congress can be found here.
Incyte Investor Event and Webcast
Incyte will host an investor event and webcast on Monday, October 26, 2026 from 7:30 – 9:00 CET / 2:30 – 4:00 p.m. ET to discuss key data presented at ESMO and provide portfolio updates.
The event will be webcast and can be accessed via the Events and Presentations tab of the Investor section of Incyte.com. A replay will be available for 30 days.
